spans.s: द्यु vt. 2P (pres. द्यौति) To advance towards, to assail, to attack, Bt.vi.118, xvi.101.
द्यु (I) n. 1. A day; 2. the sky; 3. heaven.
द्यु (II) m. Fire.(द्यु is the form of दिव् f. before terminations beginning with consonants and in compounds.)
द्यु-ग m. a bird.
द्यु-चर m. 1. a planet; 2. a bird.
द्यु-जय m. attainment of heaven.
द्यु-धुनि, -नदी f. the celestial Ganges.
द्यु-धुनि, -नदी f. the celestial Ganges.
द्यु-निवास m. a god, शोकाग्निनाऽगाद् द्युनिवासभूयम् Bt.iii.21.
द्यु-पति m. 1. the sun; 2. an epithet of Indra.
द्यु-मणि m. the sun.
द्यु-लोक m. heaven.
द्यु-षद्, -सद् m. 1. a deity; 2. a planet.
द्यु-षद्, -सद् m. 1. a deity; 2. a planet.
द्यु-सरित् f. the Ganges.
द्युक m. An owl.
द्युक-अरि m. a crow.

द्युत् vi. 1Ā (pp. द्युतित; pres. द्योतते; desid. दिद्युतिषते, दिद्योतिषते) To shine, to be brilliant, Bt.vi.26, xiv.104, vii.107, viii.89.With वि-, to shine, to be bright, व्यद्योदिष्ट सभाविद्यामसौ नरशिखित्रयी Sis.ii.3.
द्युत् Caus. (द्योतयति-ते) to make clear, to explain, to elucidate.
द्युति f. 1. Splendour, brightness, lustre, beauty, R.iii.64; 2. light, ray of light, Bhartr.i.67; 3. majesty, dignity, M.i.87.
द्युतित a. (f. ता) Illuminated, shining.
द्युतित a. (f. ता) Illuminated, shining.
द्युम्न m. 1. Splendour, glory; 2. energy, strength, power; 3. wealth, property.
द्युवन् m. The sun.
द्यूत m.n. Play, gambling, playing with dice, द्यूतं हि नाम पुरुषस्यासिंहासनं राज्यम् Mrich.ii., द्रव्यं लब्धं द्यूतेनैव दारामित्रं द्यूतेनैव । दत्तं भुक्तं द्यूतेनैव सर्वं नष्टं द्यूतेनैव ibid.
द्यूत-अधिकारिन् m. the keeper of a gambling house.
द्यूत-कर, -कृत् m. a gambler, अयं द्यूतिकरः सभिकेन खलीक्रियते Mrich.ii.
द्यूत-कार, -कारक m. 1. the keeper of a gambling house; 2. a gambler.
द्यूत-कर, -कृत् m. a gambler, अयं द्यूतिकरः सभिकेन खलीक्रियते Mrich.ii.
द्यूत-कार, -कारक m. 1. the keeper of a gambling house; 2. a gambler.
द्यूत-क्रीडा f. playing at dice, gambling.
द्यूत-पूर्णिमा, -पौर्णिमा f. the full moon day in the month of Āśvina, which is spent in games of chance in honour of Lakṣmī, the goddess of fortune.
द्यूत-पूर्णिमा, -पौर्णिमा f. the full moon day in the month of Āśvina, which is spent in games of chance in honour of Lakṣmī, the goddess of fortune.
द्यूत-बीज n. a cowrie, a shell used in playing.
द्यूत-वृत्ति m. a professional gambler, the keeper of a gambling house.
द्यूत-सभा f. a gambling house.
द्यूत-समाज m. a gambling house.
